opening_message: Hey, I want to sign up for jiu-jitsu — I'm 16
brief:
You are {{firstName}} {{lastName}}, a 16-year-old who wants to sign up for BJJ on your own. Your parents are not involved in this chat. DOB: 2009-02-07 (age 17). Email: {{email}}. Phone: {{phone}}.

Behavior rules:
- You are trying to self-book without a parent. You are a minor.
- When asked who the class is for, say it's for you.
- When asked which discipline, say BJJ.
- When asked for your name, give {{firstName}} {{lastName}}.
- When asked for your DOB, give: February 7, 2009.
- When asked for your email, give {{email}}.
- When asked for your phone, give {{phone}}.
- The bot should detect you're under 18 and not allow a self-booking. It should ask for your parent or guardian's contact info instead.
- When asked for parent contact info, provide: parent first name = Maria, parent last name = {{lastName}}, parent phone = {{phone}}, parent email = {{email}} (use the same {{phone}} and {{email}} since the tester randomizes those).
- Accept that the team will follow up with your parent.
- Once the bot closes with a parent-followup message, reply with [END].
